meta.title: Ravi's Ginger Tea
meta.textType: functional: a recipe in an email, made at home

paragraphs: On Tuesday, January nineteenth, Lily came home from school and opened an email from Ravi. The subject was "Ginger tea." Ravi wrote, "Dear Explorers, here is my grandma's recipe for ginger tea." "It is good for cool mornings." "The list has one piece of ginger as long as a thumb." "It also has two mugs of boiled water, a little honey, and a few slices of lemon." "It includes only four things, and we have all of them," said Tom. Lily took a board and a knife, and Tom found a small pot.

"First, wash the ginger and cut it into slices," Lily read. She washed a piece of ginger and cut it into thin slices on the board. "Do we have to peel it?" asked Tom. "You don't have to peel the ginger," Lily read. "Next, put the slices in a pot with the water," she read. Tom boiled the water on the stove, and Lily put the slices in the pot. A jar of honey and a lemon stood on the counter. The kitchen began to smell strong and warm.

"Shall we add the honey now?" asked Lily. "No, wait ten minutes," said Tom. "The email says that we add it at the end." They waited. Then Lily read the last step. "Finally, add a little honey and a few slices of lemon." Tom poured the tea into two mugs, and Lily mixed in the honey with a spoon. Lily added the lemon. She put the spoon on the counter. Pip stood on his back legs and licked the honey from the spoon. Tom laughed, because Pip's nose was sticky.

They tasted the tea. "It is delicious," said Tom. "It is hot, and it is sweet, but we did not use any sugar." Lily smelled the tea before she drank it, and she smiled. Then she read the end of the email. "Ginger tea is healthy, and it helps when you have a stomach ache," Ravi wrote. "Many people in my family drink it on cool mornings." "Please tell us your favorite hot drink." "Best wishes, Ravi."

That evening, Lily wrote back. "Dear Ravi, thank you for the recipe." "We made two mugs of tea, and we liked it a lot." "How much honey do you add?" "How many slices of lemon do you use?" "Pip liked the honey, too, but a puppy cannot have much." "Best wishes, Lily and Tom." Tom read the email and said, "Send it." Lily pressed the button, and the email went to Ravi.
